title: Cogent Communications Sees AI Traffic Upside, but Infrastructure Bottlenecks Loom

content_html:
MarketBeat

Wed, August 12, 2026 at 7:04 PM PDT 6 min read

Key Points

  • Interested in Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • AI is accelerating Cogent's traffic and wavelength opportunities: Internet traffic growth rose to 16% year over year in the second quarter, while wavelength revenue increased 68% year over year and 9.2% sequentially. Wavelength services now attract hyperscalers and AI-focused "neoclouds," though they remain only about 6% of revenue.

  • Infrastructure bottlenecks could delay AI-related revenue: Shortages of power, data centers, GPUs, servers and memory are preventing some customers from deploying wavelength connections. Cogent expects these constraints to persist for roughly two years, with permitting, water and political issues posing longer-term challenges.

  • Cogent still must restore overall revenue growth: The company has experienced three years of declines following the Sprint acquisition runoff, despite cost reductions and EBITDA expansion. Management is focused on balance-sheet improvement, margin discipline and returning the business to top-line growth.

  • Big Dippers: 3 Stocks Near 1-Year Lows That Could Surge in 2025

Cogent Communications (NASDAQ:CCOI) Chief Executive Officer Dave Schaeffer said the company is positioned to benefit from growing artificial intelligence infrastructure demand through both higher internet traffic and increased demand for optical wavelength services, though he cautioned that deployment bottlenecks may delay the pace at which that opportunity is reflected in financial results.

Speaking at an Oppenheimer conference with communications analyst Tim Moran, Schaeffer said Cogent, which he described as the world's largest carrier of internet traffic, has seen traffic growth accelerate. Year-over-year traffic growth rose to 16% in the second quarter from 12% in the first quarter, he said.

Schaeffer compared AI's potential impact on internet traffic with prior demand waves from streaming and gaming. He said AI will be distributed through and integrated into the internet, increasing traffic volumes while also changing traffic patterns as users upload data for processing through large language models.

AI Training Supports Wavelength Demand

In addition to internet transit, Schaeffer said AI development is supporting demand for Cogent's wavelength business, which provides optical transport between locations. He said AI developers often need to connect data storage locations with separate facilities used to train large language models.

市场节奏

太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 8 月 12 日星期三晚上 7:04 阅读 6 分钟

要点

  • 对 Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. 感兴趣？ 这是我们更喜欢的五只股票。
  • AI正在加速Cogent的流量和波长机会：第二季度互联网流量同比增长至16%，而波长收入同比增长68%，环比增长9.2%。 Wavelength 服务现在吸引了超大规模企业和专注于人工智能的“新云”，尽管它们仍然只占收入的 6% 左右。
  • 基础设施瓶颈可能会延迟人工智能相关收入：电力、数据中心、GPU、服务器和内存的短缺阻碍了一些客户部署波长连接。 Cogent 预计这些限制将持续大约两年，而许可、水和政治问题将构成长期挑战。
  • Cogent 仍必须恢复整体收入增长：尽管成本降低且 EBITDA 扩张，但在收购 Sprint 后，该公司经历了三年的下滑。 管理层的重点是改善资产负债表、控制利润率并使业务恢复营收增长。
  • 北斗七星：3只接近一年低点的股票可能在 2025 年飙升

Cogent Communications（纳斯达克股票代码：CCOI）首席执行官戴夫·谢弗（Dave Schaeffer）表示，该公司将通过更高的互联网流量和对光波长服务需求的增加，从不断增长的人工智能基础设施需求中受益，不过他警告说，部署瓶颈可能会延迟这一机会在财务业绩中体现的速度。

Schaeffer 在与通信分析师 Tim Moran 举行的奥本海默会议上发表讲话时表示，他将 Cogent 描述为全球最大的互联网流量运营商，该公司的流量增长速度正在加快。 他表示，第二季度的同比流量增长率从第一季度的 12% 升至 16%。

→ AST SpaceMobile 收益提醒投资者太空领域的风险有多大

  • 2只提供卓越回报的中型电信股

谢弗将人工智能对互联网流量的潜在影响与之前流媒体和游戏的需求浪潮进行了比较。 他表示，人工智能将通过互联网进行分发并集成到互联网中，从而增加流量，同时随着用户上传数据通过大型语言模型进行处理而改变流量模式。

AI培训支持波长需求

Schaeffer 表示，除了互联网传输之外，人工智能的开发还支持 Cogent 波长业务的需求，该业务提供不同地点之间的光传输。 他表示，人工智能开发人员通常需要将数据存储位置与用于训练大型语言模型的单独设施连接起来。
